notes.input: The model is given each branch's own scene graph, physical properties and action program (for an intervention the action with its timed change), as in forward scoring; 10 sampling steps, question seed 0.
notes.outcome: Outcome phrases are measured from the PhysX states and from the predicted states with one rule per set (outcome_rule). A set is listed only when the model's outcome equals PhysX's in every shown branch: the same class or count, and measured distances within 0.15 m or 15%. A variant is listed for a set only when it meets this in every branch with a position error of at most 0.06 m (Reg) or 0.08 m (FM, DDPM).
notes.error: error_m is the position error in metres on this simulation: the mean distance of the moving objects from PhysX over the generated frames.
notes.render: One camera, floor and exposure per set. The floor's colour and texture are changed at render time only; the motion is the simulation's. A piece a model puts below the floor is lifted onto it.
notes.overlay: Arrow coordinates are normalised to the tile (0..1 from the top-left); arrows show direction only. An intervention adds a second entry with its time.

sets.description: A gripper lets go of a ball at the top of a ramp. The ball rolls down, pushes a spring-mounted block and topples a row of tiles.
sets.outcome_rule: A piece counts as fallen when it ends tilted more than 45 degrees from its start.
